faqs.question: What is GEOSITION?
faqs.answer: GEOSITION audits AI search readiness and suggests fixes. Its score estimates observable technical and content signals, not actual citations or rankings.

faqs.question: How is the GEO score calculated?
faqs.answer: The readiness score covers crawler access (25 points), schema (16), metadata (20), content (21), technical signals (8), and brand and entity (10). Optional llms.txt and AI discovery checks do not affect the score.

faqs.question: What are the 47 GEO methods?
faqs.answer: A separate content analysis uses research-informed and product-defined heuristics. It does not measure citations or guarantee an increase in visibility.

faqs.question: How do I use GEOSITION with Claude or Cursor?
faqs.answer: GEOSITION includes an MCP server with 12 tools. Install with: pip install geosition[mcp], then: claude mcp add geosition -- geo-mcp. You can then ask Claude to audit sites, generate fixes, and analyze citability directly.

faqs.question: Can I run GEO audits in CI/CD?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use the GitHub Action: uses: arnaudbellemare/geosition@v1 with url and threshold inputs. Supports SARIF output for GitHub Security tab and JUnit for Jenkins/GitLab. Fails the build if score drops below threshold.

faqs.question: What AI bots does GEOSITION track?
faqs.answer: GEOSITION tracks 27 AI bots across 3 tiers: training (GPTBot, anthropic-ai, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, cohere-ai, Bytespider, CCBot, and more), search/citation (OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Bingbot, xAI-Bot, DuckAssistBot, YouBot, Amazonbot), and user-fetch (ChatGPT-User, Perplexity-User, Meta-ExternalFetcher, facebookexternalhit). Critical citation bots: OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot.
